[Data]
msdosinitiated="1"
floppyless="1"

winntupgrade="no"

OriTyp="5"
[Unattended]
DriverSigningPolicy=Ignore
NonDriverSigningPolicy=Ignore

OemSkipEula=Yes
OemPreinstall=No

WaitForReboot=No

[GuiUnattended]
OEMSkipRegional=1

AdminPassword=*
EncryptedAdminPassword=No
[UserData]
FullName="Jan"
OrgName=""
ComputerName=USOS-XP
[Identification]
JoinWorkgroup=WORKGROUP
[Networking]
InstallDefaultComponents=Yes
[SetupParams]
UserExecute="C:\USOS\XP\pae.exe"
[GuiRunOnce]
Command0="%SystemDrive%\USOS\XP\pae.exe /firstlogon"

----- usos-users.cmd -----
@echo off
rem USOS: local administrator accounts from usos-xp.ini, run hidden by pae.exe at setup end.
set USOS_LOG=%SystemRoot%\usos-users.log
net user "Jan" /add >> "%USOS_LOG%" 2>&1
for %%G in (Administrators Administratorzy Administratoren Administrateurs Administradores Administratori) do net localgroup %%G "Jan" /add >> "%USOS_LOG%" 2>&1
exit /b 0
